title: engine:F10 — Retained asset creation and provenance ledger semantics
description:
Create and retain canonical inventory, property, XP, and other source-defined
assets with auditable ownership and provenance.

ROOT CAUSE: character progression and inventory structures exist, but there is
no owner for the full retained-asset creation and provenance contract. The
current engine:F10 family owns the currency and downtime surface; asset CREATION
with retained provenance crosses that boundary. An asset that appears in
inventory without a recorded origin cannot be audited, replayed, or reconciled
against canon — which is the same class of defect as the pack's fabricated
starting-wealth table, expressed at runtime instead of at compile time.

LEDGER ROW: capabilityId engine:F10, primitive
"retained-inventory-property-xp-asset-creation".
Pack membership: records whose data.executionReadiness hooks qualify as
engine:F10 with retained asset creation, inventory, property, or XP semantics.
Source omissions are compared separately.

CROSSES: engine:F5 (item-instance state) and engine:F4 (spell-driven asset
creation — coordinate with the spellbook-copy primitive under eshyra-o9bd.19.5.5).
engine:F10 owns it.

REQUIRED INVARIANT: every retained asset records how it came to exist. Creation
without provenance is not permitted, and provenance is auditable after the fact
rather than reconstructed.

PROVENANCE: this bead exists because the bootstrap capability ledger
(eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1, PR #477) found this primitive had NO owner in the current
family decomposition. It was recorded there as ownershipStatus=proposed-new-bead;
this bead is that proposal made real, and the ledger row now points here.

CROSS-FAMILY PRIMITIVE. The owning family is named in the title, but the
requirement crosses family boundaries. Per the authorization criteria on
eshyra-olc5.1, a cross-family primitive is named ONCE and assigned ONE owning
family — do not re-implement it under the families it touches. Coordinate
instead.

SEQUENCING: this bead is blocked by its family's decomposition task and must not
be started before it. Decomposition does not RE-CREATE this bead; it reconciles
against it, decides whether the primitive splits further, and names the
conformance scenarios. Duplicating it under a sibling family is the failure mode
to avoid.

GREEN BAR: the nine-point definition on eshyra-o9bd.19 applies — this primitive
is not done until a provider-neutral implementation exists, reference-engine
conformance tests exercise the committed PACK representation (not a fixture),
tool exposure and state mutation are correct, unsupported input fails CLOSED,
and replay / deterministic equivalence holds where applicable.

COUNT HYGIENE: membership comes from the ledger's generated query for this
primitive. Never hand-copy a hook count into an acceptance test.

*** engine:F* IS A QUALIFIED PREFIX. engine:F1..F10 are the pack's
executionReadiness engineHooks families — NOT the CLOSED epic eshyra-2n1t's
different F1-F10, and NOT the fable:F1..F8 audit findings.
acceptance_criteria:
• Every retained asset — inventory, property, XP, and source-defined assets — records auditable creation provenance.
• Asset creation without provenance is unreachable, not merely discouraged.
• Provenance survives save/restore and is correct under replay.
• Conformance tests drive creation from the committed pack representation.
• Unsupported input fails CLOSED rather than creating an unprovenanced asset.
• The engine:F10 ledger membership query returns zero unowned clauses for this primitive.
